answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 16829 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Mu` meneen Brother, As Salaam Aleikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. Allah has blessed one more son to my friend on Eid Ul Fitr day in Dubai. He has already three sons and their names are FAIZAN, FARHAN & SUBHAN. My friend and his wife would like to give name for their fourth son as FURKAN. Before finalizing this name, they would like to know your opinion. Can you please give your thought on this name and if you feel to suggest different names, then please go ahead and give the names which are much better than this. Your quick reply will be highly appreciated. Jazak Allah Khair! Question: Mu` meneen Brother, As Salaam Aleikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. Allah has blessed one more son to my friend on Eid Ul Fitr day in Dubai. He has already three sons and their names are FAIZAN, FARHAN & SUBHAN. My friend and his wife would like to give name for their fourth son as FURKAN. Before finalizing this name, they would like to know your opinion. Can you please give your thought on this name and if you feel to suggest different names, then please go ahead and give the names which are much better than this. Your quick reply will be highly appreciated. Jazak Allah Khair! Answer ID: 16829 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2043/1648/H=1430) The name Furqan chosen by parents is better. May Almighty Allah bestow him good fortune in both the worlds and keep him away from evils, and accept him for the service of Islam. Amen! However, some other names on your demand are written here: (1) Sadan (2) Adnan (3) Ehsan (4) Imran (5) Sauban (6) Mus?ab (7) Huzaifa (8) Abu Obaidah (9) Salman (10) Affan (11) Usman (12) Abban Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
